value.rationale: The dodecahedron is the canonical 20-vertex cubic Platonic graph and generalized Petersen GP(10,2); the exact attractor numbers, 16-cell first-entry basin distribution, seven-step sharp clock, absence of late two-cycle attraction, and full 120-symmetry quotient are natural, non-implied invariants for synchronous nonlinear majority voting. Structural matching-cut interpretation yields 59 complementary stable partitions. These provide a complete graph-specific classification with potential utility as a benchmark for recurrence and symmetry computations, rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
